req.title: Session cookie has HttpOnly attribute
req.statement: The system shall set HttpOnly on the session cookie.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the session cookie must have the HttpOnly attribute set for security reasons. This ensures that the cookie cannot be accessed via JavaScript, mitigating certain types of attacks such as XSS. The test suite includes a positive test to verify the correct setting of the HttpOnly attribute, a negative test to ensure the absence of the attribute results in an error, and a boundary test to check the behavior when the session is cleared.

tests.name: test_session_cookie_httponly_positive
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Log in to set the session cookie
r = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Rahul', 'password': 'stone'})
assert r.status_code == 302

# Check the session cookie
cookie = r.headers.get('Set-Cookie')
assert 'HttpOnly' in cookie

tests.name: test_session_cookie_httponly_negative
actions: Attempt to access a protected endpoint
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Attempt to access a protected endpoint without logging in
r = client.get('/create')
assert r.status_code == 302
assert '/auth/login' in r.headers['Location']

tests.name: test_session_cookie_httponly_boundary
actions: Log out to clear the session
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Log in to set the session cookie
r = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Rahul', 'password': 'stone'})
assert r.status_code == 302

# Log out to clear the session
r = client.get('/auth/logout')
assert r.status_code == 302

# Check the session cookie is cleared
cookie = r.headers.get('Set-Cookie')
assert 'session=;' in cookie
